title: Ing siwala laban kareng maling timbang
intro: Ing metung a tapat a kaladwa meragul ya libutad da ring negosyanti at negosyanti king metung a labuad nung nukarin ing timbangan makatikdo ya at ding sukad mipakuyad la. Ing indibidwal a ini tinalakad yang magdili-dili laban king e katapatan ning mabilug a bangsa, inaus na la king katarungan at pamanyamba king Metung a Tune Dios. Agyang malino ing mensahi at makatarungan ing tawag, e la bisang makiramdam deng tau at arapan da ing makalunus a kapalaran. Malyari meng akilala ining marangal a tubud ibat keng Quran?
clues: Mitubud ku anting tubud karing memalen a ing karelang kabyayan makapadurut king kalakalan at kalakalan.
Pikabaluan la ding memalen ku king mabilug a yatu uling mamye lang makuyad a sukad at maglinlang king timbang.
Petakutan da la naman ding maglakbe king dalan at kinalat ing korapsyon king mabilug a yatu.
Inamuyut ku la na samban de ing Allah mu at maging tapat la keng karelang pamakipag-ugnayan kareng aliwa.
Tinggap da ing kanakung mensahi at menakut lang palayasan da ku at ding kayabe kung talasalpantaya king bansa.
Iligtas na ku ning Allah ampo ding talatuki ku kapamilatan ning keyang lunus, kabang ding taung e mayap mesira la king metung a makalunus a parusa.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
